items.text: Zay Flowers on field in Brazil testing hamstring; said to look good as Ravens mull decision. Still true GTD, not counting on him earlier.
items.why: Pregame test ongoing; visual positive but decision pending.
items.implication: Monitor closely ~90 min pre-kick; late swap critical.
items.opportunity: If IN unexpected, reverse Bateman/Andrews beneficiaries.
items.conflict: ETR/Levitan OUT proj vs positive warmup.

items.text: Actives: Jalen Coker, DJ Moore, Keon Coleman, Jaylen Warren, Brian Burns. Inactives: AD Mitchell, Xavier Legette, Devin Singletary, Joey Porter Jr. Tyjae Spears up.
items.implication: Coker up (Legette out); Mitchell out boosts Wilson; Spears active.
items.opportunity: Garrett Wilson full; Coker volume; Spears pass-downs.

items.text: AD Mitchell expected inactive (finger); Jets WRs: Wilson, Isaiah Williams, Pritchett, Shepard, McLain. Expect TE Kenyon Sadiq slot/wide work.
items.implication: Wilson clear WR1; deep options limited.
items.opportunity: Garrett Wilson target monopoly; Sadiq sleeper.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder, Q) expected to play vs Chargers and is active. Keon Coleman also active. Jaylen Warren active.
items.why: Source confirmation; limited practice but expected/active.
items.implication: Start Moore (possibly limited snaps); full Bills WR corps.
items.opportunity: Moore targets alongside Coleman; Warren volume with Dowdle out.

items.text: Levitan: Projecting Zay Flowers (hamstring) OUT right now despite GTD; late swap ready for Bateman/Andrews DFS. Moore in but limited; AD Mitchell out. Warren/Evans/Bowers projected IN despite Q.
items.why: Team not counting on him; hamstring history; keep late swap.
items.implication: Avoid Flowers; pivot to Bateman/Andrews stacks with Lamar.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for Bateman, Andrews, Likely.

items.text: ETR Sunday AM summary: Zay Flowers true GTD (team not counting on him playing); projecting OUT. Expected: Jaylen Warren, Michael Pittman, Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith, Brock Bowers, Mike Evans, Jalen Coker, Keon Coleman. Q: Colby Parkinson trending right, Tyson Bagent.
items.why: Team not counting on Flowers; others expected despite Q tags.
items.implication: Bench Flowers pending final; start expected players confidently.
items.opportunity: Bateman/Andrews upside if Flowers out; Warren full role.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams Grade 2 hamstring; 3-4 week timeline per sources (w/ Rapoport). Hoping to beat it as quick healer. OUT Week 3.
items.implication: Bagent starts; Bears pass catchers downgraded short-term.
items.opportunity: Tyson Bagent streaming if healthy; Odunze/Moore volatility.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua doubtful SNF (groin impacting explosiveness); functional but not full; short-term, possible Week 4 return vs Eagles; surgery not expected.
items.why: Groin limiting explosiveness; team views short-term.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins OUT again (hamstring); decent chance return Week 4 vs Cowboys.
items.why: Missed practice all week; second straight.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz 28% target share last week continues.

items.text: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren (shoulder Q) and WR Michael Pittman (foot Q) both expected to play vs Bengals; later confirmed active for Warren.
items.implication: Start both; Warren lead with Dowdle out.
items.opportunity: Warren elevated carries/targets; Pittman return volume.

items.text: Mike Evans good to go (hip); Brock Bowers expected; Saquon Barkley/DeVonta Smith expected/active; Flowers true GTD not counted on; Spears up.
Projecting Brock Bowers IN despite Q (knee); same for Evans (hip), Warren. Major DFS implications if clarity early.
items.implication: Lock in TE1 Bowers; Evans WR2.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR; Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role (RB14 util); AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
items.why: Brooks IR expected after limited career games.

items.text: Berry LOVES Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg. Feed him.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak run D; high prop.

items.text: Berry LOVES Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches +15% targets both weeks; RB7 util; PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Berry LOVES Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, 53% air yards; LV allows 18.7 ypr); Dalton Schultz @IND (28% share w/ Collins out; IND 4th-most TE yds); Christian Watson vs ATL (WR8 util, 38% RZ).
items.opportunity: Schultz TE1 with Collins out; Olave volume.

items.text: Berry HATES Rhamondre Stevenson @JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RB); Travis Etienne vs LV (49% touches/38% 3rd down); Terry McLaurin vs SEA (fewest WR pts allowed, low team total).
items.why: Role/matchup concerns; Daniels out dings McLaurin further.
items.opportunity: Henderson closing gap on Stevenson; Hubbard lead post-Brooks.

items.text: 10 Facts: Post-Stevenson fumble, TreVeyon Henderson 65% snaps, out-touched 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but ranks Stevenson ahead still. London 20+ PPR/35% share/97 yds w/ Penix. Schultz 28-30% share w/ Collins out.
items.implication: Monitor Henderson rise; London smash w/ Penix; Schultz must-start.
items.opportunity: Henderson flex upside; Schultz TE1; London WR1.
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson > Henderson short-term.
